source:
@@U03019@@
(To 梅菲斯特.)

@@U03020@@
So, cousin, you here, too, you rascal? And just in time, too. Many thanks. It’s a lucky chance brings you. Since I exist, I must be always active, and I'd like to begin at once. You're just the one to show me a shortcut when I need it.

@@U03022@@
A word first, if you don’t mind. I’ve always found myself embarrassed by people, old and young, who bombard me with their problems. For example, they're always asking how body and soul can fit so finely together, cling so tightly, as if they'd never part, and yet they're always at each other's throats, making life miserable. And then—

@@U03024@@
Hold on there! Not so fast! Id ask, rather, why husband and wife get along so miserably? That’s one thing, friend, you'll never be clear about. There’s work to be done, and our little one here is eager.

@@U03026@@
What needs doing?

@@U03028@@
(Pointing to a side door.)

@@U03029@@
Show your talents there.

@@U03031@@
(Continues staring into the phial.)

@@U03032@@
I swear, you're the loveliest little boy!

@@U03033@@
(The side door opens to reveal 浮士德 lying on a couch.)
translation:
@@U03019@@
（对梅菲斯特。）

@@U03020@@
那么，表弟，你也在这里吗，你这个流氓？而且也很及时。非常感谢。这是一个幸运的机会给你带来的。既然我存在，我就必须一直活跃起来，而且我想立即开始。当我需要时，你只是向我展示一条捷径的人。

@@U03022@@
如果你不介意的话，先说一句话。我总是发现自己很尴尬，无论老少，他们都用他们的问题轰炸我。比如，他们总是在问，身体和灵魂如何能够如此紧密地结合在一起，紧紧地粘在一起，仿佛永远不会分开，但他们却总是互相掐着对方的喉咙，让生活变得痛苦不堪。然后——

@@U03024@@
坚持住！没那么快！我倒要问的是，为什么夫妻相处得如此悲惨？这是一件事，朋友，你永远不会清楚。还有工作要做，我们的小家伙很渴望。

@@U03026@@
需要做什么？

@@U03028@@
（指着侧门。）

@@U03029@@
在那里展示你的才华。

@@U03031@@
（继续盯着小瓶。）

@@U03032@@
我发誓，你是最可爱的小男孩！

@@U03033@@
（侧门打开，浮士德躺在沙发上。）
